parts:
Ben is the man. After about half an hour of looking at incomprehensible error messages, he asked "how old is your hard drive?" I told him that I didn't know and then he said he thought my disk was corrupt. He had to leave to teach class.

I rebooted the Mac, ran the disk utility, and found that my disk was corrupt. I spent a few minutes repairing the disk and now it runs.

Ben, I owe you. Next round of drinks are on me.



Daniel

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: RStan vignette build problems
parts:
Glad it is sometimes working. I too observed once that my ~/.R/Makevars file disappeared but I convinced myself that I must have accidentally done it myself.

The excess cores spawned error is a feature of the new R when --as-cran is specified. They only want people to test with 2 cores. I pushed a patch for that this weekend, so it should work if you are up to date.

Ben

On Tuesday, March 11, 2014 6:50:43 PM UTC-4, Daniel Lee wrote:
Well -- I found a couple things:

1) if I run make check and it runs successfully or fails while running the vignette examples, it will remove ~/.R/Makevars from my machine.

2) I didn't realized I was running off my refactor branch. The develop branch runs fine with parallel, so it must be something in the changed code. I'll try to get that fixed.



Daniel



On Tue, Mar 11, 2014 at 6:10 PM, Daniel Lee <bea...@alum.mit.edu> wrote:
I can run it fine from within R, when ~/.R/Makevars exists and has the correct CXX and CXXFLAGS.

For the last line,
1) is there a reason it would be truncated -- could that cause problems?
2) is there a limitation or could there be a weird interaction when running in parallel in R CMD check?


Daniel




On Tue, Mar 11, 2014 at 5:49 PM, Daniel Lee <bea...@alum.mit.edu> wrote:
Ok... so something weird happens. I run:
make check

It gets to "running code in 'rstan_vignette.Rnw'" (see message below):
* checking tests ...
  Running ‘doRUnit.R’
 OK
* checking for unstated dependencies in vignettes ... OK
* checking package vignettes in ‘inst/doc’ ... OK
* checking running R code from vignettes ...
   ‘rstan_vignette.Rnw’ ... failed
 ERROR
Errors in running code in vignettes:
when running code in ‘rstan_vignette.Rnw’
  ...

> seed <- 12345

> sflist1 <- mclapply(1:4, mc.cores = ifelse(WINDOWS,
+     1, 4), function(i) stan(fit = f1, seed = seed, data = schools_data,
+     chains = 1, ch .... [TRUNCATED]

  When sourcing ‘rstan_vignette.R’:
Error: 4 simultaneous processes spawned
Execution halted


But, something weird happens. The file in ~/.R/Makevars is now mysteriously gone. As in it no longer exists. WTF? Why is it getting removed??





On Tue, Mar 11, 2014 at 5:25 PM, Daniel Lee <bea...@alum.mit.edu> wrote:
I spoke too soon.

I'm still getting the weird segfault when running from within the built directory.



On Tue, Mar 11, 2014 at 4:41 PM, Daniel Lee <bea...@alum.mit.edu> wrote:
Ben is the man. After about half an hour of looking at incomprehensible error messages, he asked "how old is your hard drive?" I told him that I didn't know and then he said he thought my disk was corrupt. He had to leave to teach class.

I rebooted the Mac, ran the disk utility, and found that my disk was corrupt. I spent a few minutes repairing the disk and now it runs.

Ben, I owe you. Next round of drinks are on me.



Daniel



On Tue, Mar 11, 2014 at 3:30 PM, Jiqiang Guo <guo...@gmail.com> wrote:
Don't know either.  It is weird.

Jiqiang


On Tue, Mar 11, 2014 at 2:49 PM, Ben Goodrich <goodri...@gmail.com> wrote:
I don't know. But can you meet at like 3:30? -- Ben
